items.title: Nut Cracker Communications Unveils New Brand Identity, Eyes Overseas Expansion - BW Marketing World
items.raw_summary: Nut Cracker Communications (NCC) today unveiled a refreshed brand identity and an expanded leadership team, marking its next phase of growth. The new identity, built around a shift from playing it safe to a bolder, more out-there approach on social, reflects how the agency has evolved: from a social-first shop into an integrated partner across social, content, creative, performance, partnerships and community building.NCC has doubled its headcount in recent quarters, expanding its creative, social, content and strategy teams while strengthening leadership across verticals."We have always built our team around the brands we serve, not the other way round," said Udit Jain, Founder of Nut Cracker Communications. “India is where we've built our craft, and Delhi NCR and Mumbai are where most of our clients are. We want to be closer to them, with more hands and sharper ideas. Overseas expansion is the natural next chapter, because the way people use social and culture online doesn't stop at a border.”NCC has further strengthened its leadership team with Ajeyshwar Dayal, ex-Vayner, IPG and Dentsu, joining as Creative Director, and Aaron Anshu Lawrence as Assistant Director - Content, with both overseeing the creative and content teams.NCC works with brands across the auto sector, FMCG, alcobev, hospitality, fintech, entertainment, travel and technology. Its current client portfolio includes Škoda Auto India, iQOO India, and Flipkart among others. The agency says its growth has come largely from the strength of this work, and it is now in conversation with a number of other brands that may join its roster.The agency offers an integrated mix of creative, digital, influencer and performance marketing services, combining strategic insights and data to create and measure campaigns.On the regional plan, NCC intends to enter select overseas markets in FY 2027-28, while doubling down on India presence and expansion beyond the NCR and Mumbai.
